repair.reason: Blocking finding A (D4 focused repair pass): the original c2 evidence only showed the SINGLETON REPOSITORY never creates a second row — it did not show the DATABASE rejects a raw insert of a second id, so 'singleton enforced (exactly one row)' was overclaimed for a table whose only enforcement was `id TEXT PRIMARY KEY` (which permits any number of distinct-id rows).
repair.fix: Added `CHECK (id = 'promotion_trust_state')` to the `id` column in both the SQLite CREATE TABLE (apps/api_server/src/database/migrations.ts) and the Postgres CREATE TABLE (apps/api_server/src/database/postgres_bootstrap.ts). Both CREATE TABLE statements are the table's own fresh DDL — this table exists only on this not-yet-integrated D4 branch, so editing it directly (rather than an ALTER on an existing table) preserves the additive-migration policy for tables that HAVE shipped.
